steps.content:
23:39, November 30, N.F. 114
MBCC Underground Training Ground
The training ground is eerily quiet at midnight, yet the only person "training" there remains exceptionally elusive.
She's too small and thin.

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: ...Bam.

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: ...Bam.

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: ...Bam.
You like shooting?
Startled by your sudden presence, she hastily withdraws her raised hands back to her chest.
Though she seems to have forgotten there was no actual gun in her hands, only fingers mimicking one.

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: I... I wasn't...

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: ...Eek!
As she tries to run away, she trips over her own feet and tumbles to the ground. When you move closer to help her up, she flinches a few more inches in fear.

options: Alright, I'll step back. Don't be scared.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But you're hurt. You need to visit the infirmary. Should I get Jelena?

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: Wait!
She hurriedly grabs your arm.

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: I... I sneaked out... Please don't tell Jelena...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Alright, I won't tell her. Would you let me take a look at it?
Sensing no objection from her, you bring over a chair, help her sit down, and examine her injury.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It'll heal in a few days, but you'll need to hide it well. Otherwise, Jelena might notice when you get back.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I know how you feel. When I was young and found myself in trouble, I was also afraid of my mom finding it out and giving me a long, long lecture.

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: ...Hee.
She lets out a quiet chuckle, only to quickly catch herself.

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: Mm... That's not how it is... Jelena never lectures me.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
options: Then, you don't want to make her worry?

steps.content: The girl remains silent.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: When your foot gets better, you don't need to sneak out in the middle of the night. Just come over and have fun whenever you like.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: There are kids your age at the Bureau, and they love coming here too. They always have lots of fun. Maybe you could all become friends.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: —And we'll all help you keep it a secret from Jelena.
The girl's effort to hold back her laughter is endearing. You wonder what else you could chat about with her.
Before you can think of anything else to say, the air suddenly grows colder, and a voice emanates from behind you.
Hmm? What's there to keep from me?
You recognize Jelena's voice, though it somewhat lacks its usual warmth.
Footsteps draw near slowly. Her figure glides past you and halts in front of Elvira, bending down to examine the girl's injured foot.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: You should have been more careful... Take ample rest for the next few days. Sable will be here shortly to carry you back to your room.

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: Jelena, are you angry with me?

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: Yes, I am angry.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: I'm angry because you sneaked out to play at this late hour. Now, go back to your room.

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: Will you go with me?
Jelena shakes her head with a smile.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: Chief still has some words with me.
As she speaks, Jelena rises and gently places her hand on your shoulder. Grasping her signal, you offer Elvira a reassuring smile.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: See you tomorrow.
Elvira hesitates for a moment before finally returning your smile. A few minutes later, the bodyguard comes to escort her away.
Now, only you and Jelena remain at the training ground.
Silver threads cut through the dim underground expanse. Amidst the quiet, you can sense power coursing through them, all the while with her hand remaining on your shoulder.
With a sharp chill, one thin, taut silver thread brushes against your neck. A single notion from its wielder would suffice to draw blood.
[CG 1]

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: I heard you were called to a meeting today. Did they say anything? You look rather tired.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: Please tell me if you need anything. You will have my full cooperation.
Quickly gathering your thoughts, you start explaining the situation.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Elvira is not a Sinner after all. I wish to protect her, but I can't keep her here forever. Your enemy will eventually find out that she's under my care.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: To protect you all, I must uncover the truth, find the culprit of those attacks, and eliminate the threat—as soon as possible. For this, I need your help.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The investigation isn't going well, and time is ticking away. Many are counting on you to be the breakthrough, while others fear you will become that breakthrough.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: Right, I suspected it was time they would put pressure on you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The 9th Agency wanted you, but I managed to deflect their request.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: What else can we do... We are not the Prime Minister's confidants, merely employees hired to cover up his scandals. He divulged very little to us, and I have shared all the information I know.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: Sorry that we couldn't be the linchpin in solving this case. We lack that level of influence, only insignificant as feathers in the wind.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: If there is no alternative, Chief, hand me over to them.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: This way, those people—be it the agents seeking to interrogate a witness or those with something to hide—will refrain from troubling you for a while.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: I'll buy you time.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: Sable will protect her. And...

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: Won't you protect her, too?

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: As for me, I am but a butler, an employee—replaceable at any time.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Is that so? But you seemed quite upset when I got close to her.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You used your power on me. Were you afraid I might do something rash?

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: Did I? I must have done it subconsciously.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: Forgive me, but I don't believe my power is potent enough to threaten you. You also have your shackles prepared just in case, don't you?

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: Though I may have emotional moments at times, I always regain my composure and do what needs to be done.
You look at her for a long time before speaking again.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You're always so guarded—not just with me, but with everyone who approached you at the memorial service.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So, you would never truly trust me with Elvira. Even staying at the MBCC was just a desperate compromise.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But when the time comes that you can’t protect her anymore, what will you do?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Run from here? Leave the MBCC? Get away from Eastside? Or escape DisCity altogether?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Or perhaps... something more drastic?

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: Are you going to stop us?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Why can't we work things out together?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Since we're both taking a gamble here, wouldn't it be better to have allies? I can certainly bring something helpful to the table.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: We've made a deal—you help me investigate and catch the real culprit, and I protect you three. I'm serious about it. You?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Were those words you just said out of desperation? You don't trust me 'cause you think I'm no different from the others?

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: ...How rare to find one with such candor. It's been far too long since I've met anyone like you.
You gaze at her intently, waiting for her true thoughts to emerge.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: My apologies. I don't intend to act rashly, nor do I doubt your integrity.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: You saved the West District and defeated Black Rings—a true hero indeed. Elvira is incredibly fortunate to be under your protection.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: So please, feel free to give me your instructions. As long as no harm comes to El, I will do it in any manner possible.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: However, Chief, what we need is not a hero who can save the world. My only wish is to protect this one person from the storm.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: And that, more often than not, is so much harder than saving the world.
(Scene change)
Through the surveillance monitor, you watch as Jelena returns to Elvira's room. She exchanges a courteous nod with S9, who is standing guard outside, before entering.
Elvira wakes up.

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: ...I'm sorry, Jelena. I didn't mean to make you angry.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: It's all right, El. I understand you are frightened.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: Would you like a real little handgun of your own?
El shakes her head vigorously and buries herself in Jelena's arms.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: Maybe next time, then.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: Good night.
The night holds the two inside in its embrace, accompanied by the soft, soothing singing of a lullaby.
[Black Screen]
In your office, you listen quietly, only to turn off the surveillance monitor long after the singing stops.
You then pick up your communication device and make several calls.
[Black Screen]

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Hey, Chief ${PlayerName}! Haha, so you saw that show? My bad, go ahead and let me have it! Feel free to ring me up anytime to give me a piece of your mind!

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: But at this late hour, you must've called me for something, right?
[Television]

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: Breaking news again! Max King has just made an emergency announcement, and this-this is absolutely massive! His approval ratings are skyrocketing!

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: ...Breaking news, huh. What the heck is that guy doing?

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Yes, my friends, I'm back! The Viers attack incident turned out to be quite the adventure—not only did I cross paths with Chief ${PlayerName}, but I also connected with a vital witness.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Her existence links together all the Election Surprises, exposing the true darkness that touches every corner of our city. So, I must also conceal her identity until the investigation is complete—for her good of course.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: However, citizens, worry not—this witness will soon be relocated to the 9th Agency, where she will be granted the highest level of protection while her valuable insights can be put to optimal use.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Hmph... Did you hear that, you vermin lurking in the shadows? Your days of hiding are numbered. The tide is turning...
Meanwhile, in a secluded corner of the city, a stick of incense is lit.

Amidst the swirling incense smoke, several shadowy figures emerge, their eyes locked on the man on the television screen, hanging on his every word and meticulously noting every individual he mentions.
And...
...Well, then... time for a little chat with them...
